intro: "Grimand's Armor" is the culmination of a warrior's training questline under the supervision of Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. After proving the viability of Furen Longbeard's metallurgic techniques, the smith crafts a formidable piece of armor capable of absorbing punishing blows in battle. It marks an essential milestone in an Alliance warrior's journey toward mastery.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely believe it! Furen's technique was a success, and this armor should withstand tremendous levels of stress.
Here you are, friend. And thank you. I wouldn't have believed Furen's discovery if you hadn't gathered the materials I needed to test it myself.
